subject: how are you

hook.say: There are four answers to how are you, and only one of them is an answer.

types.name: The Honest
types.say: You tell them. Sometimes that's a lot for a Tuesday.

types.name: The Autopilot
types.say: Good, you? You don't even hear the question anymore.

types.name: The Deflect
types.say: You turn it into a joke and change the subject.

types.name: The Overshare
types.say: They asked. They're getting everything.

kicker.say: Ask twice. The second answer is the real one.

caption: The person who says fine the fastest is usually the one who isn't.

subject: how people show love

hook.say: People show love in four languages. Most of us are only fluent in one.

types.name: Words
types.say: You say it. Specifically, and often.

types.name: Time
types.say: You give the hours. Undivided, phone down.

types.name: Acts
types.say: You fix the thing they didn't ask you to fix.

types.name: Gifts
types.say: You noticed something six weeks ago. It's here now.

kicker.say: You're probably loving them the way you want to be loved. Try their way.
lines: the way *you* want to be loved.

caption: Most people who feel unloved are being loved in a language they don't speak.

subject: when others succeed

hook.say: When someone you know succeeds, four things happen inside you.

types.name: The Celebrate
types.say: Genuinely happy for them. That's rarer than it should be.

types.name: The Compare
types.say: You're happy for them and suddenly behind.

types.name: The Learn
types.say: You ask how they did it. You take notes.

types.name: The Withdraw
types.say: You go quiet for a while and call it being busy.

kicker.say: Comparison isn't a character flaw. It's data about what you actually want.

caption: If their win makes you feel behind, it's showing you the thing you're not admitting you want.

subject: how people argue

hook.say: Every argument has four possible moves. Most people only know two.

types.name: Escalate
types.say: Volume goes up, accuracy goes down.

types.name: Withdraw
types.say: You leave the room and take the point with you.

types.name: Repair
types.say: You say the thing that lowers the temperature, even when you're right.

types.name: Logic
types.say: You win the facts and lose the person.

kicker.say: You can be right or you can be close. Sometimes both. But never right first.

caption: The most damaging move in an argument isn't shouting. It's leaving.

subject: cancelled plans

hook.say: Your plans got cancelled. Your reaction tells you how tired you actually are.

types.name: Relief
types.say: Instant peace. You were going to cancel anyway.

types.name: Annoyed
types.say: You'd already done your hair.

types.name: Neutral
types.say: Genuinely fine either way. Rare, and slightly suspicious.

types.name: Panic
types.say: Empty evening, no plan, no buffer. Now it's just you.

kicker.say: If every cancellation feels like relief, the problem isn't the plan.

caption: Relief is information. It usually means you've been saying yes past your limit.

subject: one free evening

hook.say: You have one free evening. Four people, four very different nights.

types.name: The Planner
types.say: You fill it. Something useful, something social, something.

types.name: The Scroll
types.say: You sit down for a minute. It is now midnight.

types.name: The People
types.say: You text three people and see who's free.

types.name: The Nothing
types.say: You do absolutely nothing and feel weirdly great about it.

kicker.say: An evening without output isn't wasted. It's how you stay a person.

caption: You don't need to earn your rest. You need to stop treating it like a reward.
